messages.author: Bruno Cramer
messages.body:
Hi,
after *cmake_run*, without any error indication,* sudo make install *ended
with the following error:
----------------------
bcramer.Schrodinger:~/amber20_src/build$
Error: Symbol ‘atompositions_fce’ at (1) has no IMPLICIT type
make[2]: ***
[AmberTools/src/rism/CMakeFiles/sander_rism_interface.dir/build.make:63:
AmberTools/src/rism/CMakeFiles/sander_rism_interface.dir/amber_rism_interface.F90.o]
Error 1
make[1]: *** [CMakeFiles/Makefile2:6429:
AmberTools/src/rism/CMakeFiles/sander_rism_interface.dir/all] Error 2
make: *** [Makefile:152: all] Error 2
--------------------------
Environment:
export  AMBERHOME=/home/bcramer/amber20_src/amber.sh
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${AMBERHOME}/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
export DO_PARALLEL="mpirun -np 4"
--------------------
OS: Ubuntu v20.04 LTS
-------------------
Any help is welcome
Regards
Bruno

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Nov 20, 2020, Bruno Cramer wrote:
>bcramer.Schrodinger:~/amber20_src/build$
>Error: Symbol ‘atompositions_fce’ at (1) has no IMPLICIT type
This is an odd error: is there any line number given?  As far as I can
see, all references to atompositions_fce are inside #ifdef RISMCRDINTERP
sigils.
>export  AMBERHOME=/home/bcramer/amber20_src/amber.sh
This is wrong, but seems unrelated to what you report.  AMBERHOME is set
when you source the amber.sh script (after make install).
>OS: Ubuntu v20.04 LTS
What is the output of "gfortran --version"?
....thanks....dac
